question: The venue of the 2020 Olympic Games was _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tokyo.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Olympic Games:-**

 
 
• These are international sporting events featuring summer and winter sports competitions in which thousands of athletes from around the world participate in a variety of competitions. 
 
• **Tokyo** was awarded the **2020 Olympic Games** in** 2013**, beating **Istanbul and Madrid **in the final selection process.
 
• Tokyo had previously hosted the **Summer Olympics** in **1964**, making it the **first Asian city **to do so.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sydney**: Hosted the** 2000 **Summer Olympics.

 
 
• It is the **largest city in Australia** and the state capital of New South Wales. 
 
 
 
• **Rio:** Hosted the** 2016** Summer Olympics.
 
 
• It is the** second-largest city in Brazil** and is known for its beaches, carnival, and Christ the Redeemer statue.
 
 
 
• **Los Angeles:** Set to host the **2028 **Summer Olympics.
 
 
• It is the **largest city in California** and the second-largest city in the United States.
 
• It previously hosted the Summer Olympics in** 1932 and 1984.**
